text.card: A red giant 1,249 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.41 solar masses and 13.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,926 K at its surface.
